boundaries_chirho: No production confirmation or content mutation attempt in the browser proofs; authentication POSTs only.
No D1 migration/content write, R2 source rewrite, credential rotation, station change, canonical/certification or model change.
The counts and original 12-table row hashes were compared before/after; they are not a full-row hash of every newly loaded corpus record.
100 percent is one CSS pixel per native PNG pixel per axis, not one physical device pixel on HiDPI screens.
Tests use Chromium desktop/responsive views, not Andrew's hands-on acceptance or actual Safari/trackpad proof.
Unknown font/mixed/clipped text remains a separate decoding/review task; this view does not certify transcription.
